# tests/test_trie_insert_search.py

import pytest

# Adjust this import to match your project/module name.
from your_module import trie_insert_search


@pytest.fixture
def trie_ops():
    return trie_insert_search()


def test_search_empty_trie_returns_false(trie_ops):
    _, search = trie_ops

    assert search("") is False
    assert search("a") is False
    assert search("missing") is False


def test_insert_and_search_single_word(trie_ops):
    insert, search = trie_ops

    insert("hello")

    assert search("hello") is True


def test_search_returns_false_for_prefix_and_longer_words(trie_ops):
    insert, search = trie_ops

    insert("hello")

    assert search("hell") is False
    assert search("hello!") is False
    assert search("he") is False


def test_insert_multiple_words(trie_ops):
    insert, search = trie_ops

    insert("cat")
    insert("car")
    insert("dog")

    assert search("cat") is True
    assert search("car") is True
    assert search("dog") is True

    assert search("ca") is False
    assert search("cow") is False
    assert search("do") is False


def test_word_can_be_prefix_of_another_word(trie_ops):
    insert, search = trie_ops

    insert("app")
    insert("apple")

    assert search("app") is True
    assert search("apple") is True
    assert search("appl") is False


def test_insert_empty_string(trie_ops):
    insert, search = trie_ops

    insert("")

    assert search("") is True
    assert search("a") is False


def test_empty_string_and_non_empty_words_can_coexist(trie_ops):
    insert, search = trie_ops

    insert("")
    insert("a")

    assert search("") is True
    assert search("a") is True
    assert search("aa") is False


def test_duplicate_insert_is_idempotent(trie_ops):
    insert, search = trie_ops

    insert("repeat")
    insert("repeat")

    assert search("repeat") is True
    assert search("repea") is False


def test_search_is_case_sensitive(trie_ops):
    insert, search = trie_ops

    insert("Hello")

    assert search("Hello") is True
    assert search("hello") is False


def test_unicode_words(trie_ops):
    insert, search = trie_ops

    insert("café")
    insert("😊")

    assert search("café") is True
    assert search("cafe") is False
    assert search("😊") is True


def test_separate_tries_do_not_share_state():
    insert1, search1 = trie_insert_search()
    insert2, search2 = trie_insert_search()

    insert1("only-in-first")
    insert2("only-in-second")

    assert search1("only-in-first") is True
    assert search1("only-in-second") is False

    assert search2("only-in-second") is True
    assert search2("only-in-first") is False

def test_insert_raises_type_error_for_non_iterable_input(trie_ops, bad_word):
    insert, _ = trie_ops

    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        insert(bad_word)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("bad_word", [None, 123, object()])
def test_search_raises_type_error_for_non_iterable_input(trie_ops, bad_word):
    _, search = trie_ops

    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        search(bad_word)

    insert, _ = trie_ops

    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        insert([[]])


def test_search_raises_type_error_for_unhashable_items(trie_ops):
    _, search = trie_ops

    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        search([[]])
